prompts.machined_scratches:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: one grayscale scalar surface-detail texture, for a physically based editable material in Blender. A texture input, not a shaded photograph or material preview.
Output: single square 2048 by 2048 opaque image, texture fills every pixel. Flat orthographic view. Seamless repeat, opposite boundaries must match. Neutral grayscale only, no baked lighting, highlights, shadows, reflections, perspective, object, borders, vignette, gradient illumination, logos, text or watermark. No grid of texture maps.
Subject: a 20-centimeter patch of aluminum microstructure: subtle fine nearly horizontal machining passes, lightly overlapping shallow scratches at a few irregular angles. Dense hairline scale, not wide grooves; restrained medium-gray values. Occasional tiny dents, quiet areas and slight naturally varied scratch depth. Keep very sharp small detail, no theatrical gouges, no overlaid white line graphic.
